title: Emergency Service Call Schedule - Fire & Smoke Mitigation
content:
This schedule sets, for each Fire & Smoke Mitigation tier, the figures that govern the emergency service call: the fee, the two rate-window surcharges, the on-site arrival commitment and the late-arrival waiver.

## Schedule items

1. Emergency service call fee: Emergency service call (dispatch, safety walk and scoping) fee per dispatch, USD.
2. After-hours surcharge: Surcharge on the service call fee for an after-hours dispatch, percent.
3. Holiday surcharge: Surcharge on the service call fee for a holiday dispatch (replaces the after-hours surcharge), percent.
4. Response commitment: On-site arrival commitment from the booked call, minutes.
5. Late-arrival waiver: Whether the service call fee is waived when the crew arrives later than the commitment, boolean.

## Figures by tier

| Tier | Service call fee (USD) | After-hours surcharge | Holiday surcharge | Arrival commitment | Late-arrival waiver |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Smoke Odor Response | 169.00 | 35 percent | 60 percent | 240 minutes | Yes |
| Light Smoke and Soot Cleanup | 199.00 | 35 percent | 60 percent | 180 minutes | Yes |
| Moderate Fire and Smoke Cleanup | 239.00 | 35 percent | 60 percent | 120 minutes | Yes |
| Heavy Fire Cleanup | 289.00 | 35 percent | 60 percent | 120 minutes | Yes |
| Structural Fire Large Loss | 349.00 | 35 percent | 60 percent | 90 minutes | Yes |
| Commercial Fire Large Loss | 395.00 | 35 percent | 60 percent | 90 minutes | Yes |

## Notes on the schedule

- The surcharges are the same on every tier: 35 percent for an after-hours dispatch and 60 percent for a holiday dispatch. The holiday surcharge takes the place of the after-hours surcharge; the two are never added together.
- The arrival commitment is counted in minutes from the booked call. It shortens as the tier rises, from 240 minutes on Smoke Odor Response to 90 minutes on the two Large Loss tiers.
- The late-arrival waiver reads Yes on all six tiers.

## Reading a row (hypothetical dispatch)

A hypothetical Moderate Fire and Smoke Cleanup dispatch reads its row as follows: the fee is 239.00, a holiday dispatch would carry the 60 percent holiday surcharge in place of the 35 percent after-hours surcharge, and the crew's arrival commitment is 120 minutes from the booked call.
